reason: The condition provides that the application of section 5, article III, as to the payment of time and one-third for hours over forty a week, "shall be stayed until January 1, 1934," The stay therefore ends on its own terms on January 1, 1934, a date before June 14, 1935, which makes that date the first end of this stay. Under the owner's 2026-10-21 until-date ruling the end is recorded as the stated date, inclusive (the stay runs through the end of January 1, 1934). The exclusive reading, that the stay ends when January 1, 1934 begins, is stated as the alternative and is the more natural reading of the next clause, which makes the provisions effective "at which time"; both readings give the same stated date. The repeal of June 14, 1935 is a later event for this clause and not its end.
